sentences.en: I was dazzled by the headlights of an approaching car.
sentences.zh: 我被迎面而来的汽车大灯晃花了眼。

sentences.en: His negotiations, far from ending in failure, achieved dazzling success.
sentences.zh: 他的谈判远没有以失败告终，反而取得了令人惊叹的成功。

sentences.en: Your eyes are like round corals, dazzling and very pretty.
sentences.zh: 你的眼睛像圆润的珊瑚，光彩夺目，非常漂亮。
